punchline: At Harvard, Chris Voss was asked whether he just said no and stared people down, yet he never said the word once.
thirty_sec: Chris Voss joins a Harvard negotiation course in 2006. His first partner, Andy, is supposed to keep a quarter of his budget in reserve and loses all of it. Same thing the next day. The instructor asks if Voss just says no and stares until people cave. He never said no, he just asked questions. His tip: instead of "Do you have a few minutes?" ask "Is now a bad time to talk?"
